author: data.always
content:
I crosschecked the consensus client tagging in beacon graffiti against user-agents at Flashbots relay. There's very little conflict between the two sets which is obviously good, but it looks like the graffiti stats are quite noisy b/c it doesn't capture multi-client setups.

The main takeaways are that Lighthouse is under-represented in the dashboard (~58% of slots without graffiti tagging) and that most of the other clients are in a sense over-represented because of mutli-client configurations. Also, Prysm/Lodestar proposers seem to really not like/use Flashbots relay.
